newsitem.title: USA: QPQ Corp names C. Lawrence Rutstein CEO.
newsitem.headline: QPQ Corp names C. Lawrence Rutstein CEO.

text.p: QPQ Corp said Monday it has appointed C. Lawrence Rutstein to the position of chairman, CEO and president, replacing MItchell Rubinson.
Company representatives were not immediately available for further comment.

Rutstein, said the company, is a founder of privately-held CapQuest Partners Inc, which has made several private investments in emerging software companies. He also, said the company, serves on the board of directors of Boca Raton Capital Corp and is general partner of the Memphis Chicks AA Baseball Club.

QPQ has been a developer and operator of Domino's Pizza Stores in Poland, and has been developing and operating centers which offer primary care, medical services and medically supervised weight loss programs.
